hero.h1: Mangrove tigers, ridge-top clouds and a 120 km sea beach
hero.sub: GHORA GHURI is a Khulna-based agency running fixed-departure tours and private itineraries across all eight divisions - with the boat, permit and guide work handled before you arrive.
home.pkgSub: Fixed-departure group tours and private versions of the same routes. Every price is per person in BDT, including transport, listed stays, guides and permits noted below.
search.hint: Search names, districts, tags and description text
dest.note: Prices are indicative per-person package rates in BDT and are confirmed after enquiry.
pkg.disclaimer: Prices are per person in BDT, twin sharing, including VAT. Solo supplement and peak-season changes are confirmed in the written quote.
booking.sub: Send a request, not a payment. You get a reference instantly; the office confirms availability, then issues a proforma invoice.
booking.privacy: Nothing is charged here. Details stay in your browser in this preview build.
form.name: Main traveller's full name
form.consent: I agree that GHORA GHURI may contact me about this request and store these details.
name: Name
contact.h1: Talk to the office in Khulna
contact.sub: Saturday to Thursday, 9:00-19:00 (GMT+6). WhatsApp is the fastest way to change something mid-trip.
footer.tag: Guide-led tours of Bangladesh, run from Khulna.
footer.lic: Tour operator licensed by the Department of Tourism, Bangladesh
book.disclaimer: An estimate only. Final pricing is confirmed by the office after availability checks; 30% advance is normally required to hold beds and boats.
err.name: Enter the main traveller's full name (at least 3 characters).
err.email: Enter a valid email address, e.g. name@example.com
err.phone: Use a Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. +8801712345678 or 01712345678
err.group: For groups above 60 travellers, contact the office directly.
err.order: The end date must be the same as or later than the start date.
err.long: Online requests are capped at 45 days - email the office for longer expeditions.
err.past: The start date is in the past.
err.choice: Choose a package, or name a single destination.
err.consent: Please allow GHORA GHURI to contact you about this request.
err.captcha: Human check failed - reload the page and try again.
